boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Documented Middlebury traditions spanning the College’s winter, commencement, and theatre communities.

cards.title: Graduate in a cap and gown—then head down the Snowbowl
cards.subtitle: Midyear graduation at Middlebury College Snow Bowl
cards.notes: If you are a graduating Feb, follow the College’s event guidance for the annual post-ceremony ski-down; skiing, snowboarding, and hiking have all been part of it.
cards.short_summary: Middlebury’s midyear graduates mark completion with a snowy descent in academic regalia.
cards.evidence_claim: Middlebury says Feb Celebration has culminated in an annual ski-down since 1987, with graduates heading to the Snowbowl in caps and gowns.
cards.source_title: Middlebury Honors Class of 2025.5 at Feb Celebration
cards.access_notes: For midyear graduates; the College describes the ski-down as an annual Feb Celebration tradition.

cards.title: Build a February weekend around college ski racing
cards.subtitle: Annual student-run winter festival
cards.notes: Use the College calendar for the year’s dates, then take in the festival programming and NCAA alpine and Nordic ski events that anchor the weekend.
cards.short_summary: A long-running, student-run winter festival centered on Middlebury ski competition.
cards.evidence_claim: Middlebury identifies Winter Carnival as the nation’s oldest student-run carnival, started in 1923, and says it is traditionally held over three days in February.
cards.access_notes: Held traditionally in February; consult the College calendar and event programming for current details.

cards.title: Turn snow into a Carnival sculpture
cards.subtitle: A Winter Carnival festival activity
cards.notes: Look for the snow-sculpture activity in the annual Winter Carnival schedule and join only through the College’s organized event instructions.
cards.short_summary: Snow-sculpture making is one of the College-listed festivities surrounding Winter Carnival.
cards.evidence_claim: Middlebury lists snow-sculpture making among Winter Carnival’s festivities.
cards.access_notes: Programming varies by year; confirm whether and how to participate through current Winter Carnival information.

cards.title: Put the Carnival Ball on the winter calendar
cards.subtitle: Middlebury College Activities Board event
cards.notes: Check the year’s Winter Carnival program for the Ball’s format and entry details; the College names it among the weekend’s recurring festivities.
cards.short_summary: The Carnival Ball is a College-listed social event within Winter Carnival.
cards.evidence_claim: Middlebury lists the Carnival Ball, hosted by the Middlebury College Activities Board, as a Winter Carnival festivity.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current program details with the College; the event is associated with Winter Carnival.

cards.title: Receive a replica of a founder’s cane at graduation
cards.subtitle: Commencement keepsake and College ceremonial symbol
cards.notes: At commencement, notice the replica cane presented to graduates and the original ceremonial cane’s role in College events and Convocation.
cards.short_summary: Every Middlebury graduate receives a cane replica tied to an early College benefactor.
cards.evidence_claim: Middlebury Libraries says every graduate receives a replica of Painter’s cane, which is tapped along when “Gamaliel Painter’s Cane” is sung at reunion.
cards.access_notes: Presented to graduates; the original cane is part of College ceremonial tradition.

cards.title: Make theatre lunch a recurring conversation
cards.subtitle: Middlebury Department of Theatre tradition
cards.notes: Join the Theatre community’s every-other-week lunch to discuss productions, hear play excerpts, meet visiting alumni, or simply spend time together.
cards.short_summary: A recurring Theatre gathering that mixes lunch with conversation and performance.
cards.evidence_claim: Middlebury’s Theatre Department says students, faculty, and staff gather every other week for Friday Theatre Lunches.
cards.access_notes: Check Theatre Department communications for the current lunch schedule and participation details.

cards.title: Take the theatre department’s rapid New York show run
cards.subtitle: Early-spring Department of Theatre trip
cards.notes: Watch Theatre Department announcements for the early-spring trip, which brings students, faculty, and staff to New York City to see two shows.
cards.short_summary: A one-day theatre outing built around seeing two New York productions.
cards.evidence_claim: Middlebury’s Theatre Department describes an early-spring round trip to New York City for two shows with 60 students, faculty, and staff.
cards.access_notes: Participation and travel details are set by the Theatre Department for each trip.

cards.title: Start theatre with the First-Year Show
cards.subtitle: Faculty-directed fall ensemble production
cards.notes: Incoming students can look for the department’s First-Year Show invitation; student designers and crew help bring the fast-moving fall production together.
cards.short_summary: A faculty-directed production that welcomes incoming students into Theatre.
cards.evidence_claim: Middlebury says its Theatre Department has welcomed incoming students into the First-Year Show for more than 28 years, presenting it by Fall Family Weekend.
cards.access_notes: For incoming students; consult Theatre Department announcements for auditions and production details.

cards.title: Draw lots Friday, premiere Saturday
cards.subtitle: Open Theatre Department overnight experiment
cards.notes: If the department schedules it, join the Friday-night launch prepared for lottery-assigned roles, an 8 a.m. script deadline, and an evening premiere.
cards.short_summary: Student artists create and stage original short plays in a single day.
cards.evidence_claim: Middlebury says its 24-Hour Plays use lotteries for casting and assignments, with scripts due Saturday morning and a student-written show premiering that evening.
cards.access_notes: The Theatre Department says participation is open to all; scheduling varies.

cards.title: Send graduating theatre students off with a toast
cards.subtitle: Final-semester Theatre Department lunch ritual
cards.notes: At the semester’s final theatre lunch, younger students offer each graduating senior a farewell toast that can take the form of a song, dance, skit, or poem.
cards.short_summary: The Theatre community marks seniors’ departures with creative farewell tributes.
cards.evidence_claim: Middlebury’s Theatre Department says each graduating senior receives a farewell toast from a younger student at the final lunch of the semester.
cards.access_notes: A Theatre Department end-of-semester tradition; check the department for the current gathering details.
